identity_bootstrap.invariant: Any conversation entering an Enterprise Math RESEARCHER or RESEARCH_DRIVER role must resolve its role identity before substantive work begins and emit exactly one role-appropriate identity marker on every assistant final response while that role remains active.
entry_triggers: resume of an existing Enterprise Math conversation

TASK_RESEARCH.generic_claim_behavior: On generic task-claim intent, select the highest eligible published/runtime-continuation task from the shared work state, post CLAIM, resolve/allocate Researcher-ID and start without asking the user for a task id.
TASK_RESEARCH.completion_behavior: On task completion, persist DONE plus REVIEW_REQUEST with review objective, target/evidence/execution-log refs and requested checks in the same semantic checkpoint; do not require the user to carry the return to a Driver.

mode_resolution.rule: No-user-topic does not by itself make a generic researcher free or scheduled. EM_FREE_RESEARCHER is an explicit role/mode contract and is excluded from automatic dispatch; generic task-claim intent explicitly requests shared-state dispatch.

driver_activation.canonical_prompt: 你现在是 Enterprise Math Research Driver。按仓库 docs/RESEARCH_DRIVER_OPERATING_CONTRACT.md 工作，并读取 GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE projects/enterprise-math/DRIVER_CONTINUITY.md 恢复驾驶舱状态。continuity 只用于路由，不作为数学证据；必要 theorem/status 必须回源核验。
driver_activation.generic_review_claim_behavior: After Driver activation, generic review-claim intent selects and claims the highest eligible shared review. The issuing Driver has no exclusive review right; among comparable reviews prefer a different Driver-ID, with labeled same-Driver fallback allowed.
rules: Do not infer Driver authority from memory, repository state, task importance, prior conversations, or another Project.
Driver authority applies only after explicit activation in the current conversation and remains scoped to that conversation until the user changes it.
Role activation also triggers identity bootstrap. Preserve an existing execution handle; otherwise allocate a Driver-ID before substantive Driver work.
EM-DRIVER-01 is reserved for the explicitly designated primary Driver continuity conversation; other Driver conversations auto-allocate EM-DVR-* Driver-IDs.
Identity creation must not depend on a Driver-authored prompt for direct/self-started research.
Scheduler/shared-state CLAIMs auto-derive a Researcher-ID when researcher_id is omitted.
Driver-mediated manual relay preallocates a Researcher-ID in the dispatch envelope before the user transfers the task; the reusable taskbook itself remains instance-free.
Direct user research tasks outside a Driver relay self-allocate a Researcher-ID when the current conversation has none.
Researcher-ID identifies a RESEARCHER conversation/session instance. Driver-ID identifies a RESEARCH_DRIVER conversation/session instance.
Research mode is not encoded into identity uniqueness; mode is explicit metadata/state.

Every assistant final response emitted while an Enterprise Math RESEARCHER or RESEARCH_DRIVER role is active displays exactly one role-appropriate identity marker, including short status/completion/handoff/blocked responses.
Commentary/progress/tool-call messages are not final responses and do not require the identity footer.
Researcher visible scope is active task_id first, then FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY, otherwise TASK_RESEARCH; DIRECT is never a visible scope.
If Global-Knowledge-Sync is also emitted, the role identity marker appears immediately before it.
Semantic-checkpoint commits and research PR/handoff metadata persist role identity, research_task or research_mode, and research_role when the write surface supports it.
Legacy commits and historical identity records are not rewritten solely to rename their visible identity field.

manual_dispatch_identity.continuation_rule: same conversation preserves the same Researcher-ID; a genuinely new dispatch envelope receives a new Researcher-ID unless explicitly continuing the same conversation

update_at: task created, closed, split, merged, parked, or reprioritized
research return accepted, rejected, frozen, or returned to owner
worldview or governance change that affects roadmap interpretation
session handoff when unresolved routes remain
do_not_update_for: ordinary task/review claims already present in shared work state
facts already represented by immutable journal entries with no routing consequence

TASK_RESEARCH: Researchers may freely reason, prove, disprove, compute, experiment, formalize, browse allowed task-relevant sources, write notes, proof drafts, code, Lean, reports, handoffs, and proposal candidates inside the selected mother question.
Role policy restricts scheduling and promotion authority, not scientific exploration inside the selected task.
Researchers should not interrupt productive research merely to package every side branch.
FREE_AXIOM_DISCOVERY: Freedom includes authoring the primitive question itself, not merely pivoting inside a supplied problem.

Before candidate freeze, only the primitive substrate and binding integrity rules are default research input; the general current-result router, current agenda/history, other branch Working Truth, current-success vocabulary, tool/representation convenience, suggested questions and discovery-lens menus are not discovery priors.
The control plane deliberately supplies no default suggested-question list or discovery-lens list before the first candidate.
After candidate freeze, prior/current work may be opened for falsification, deduplication, prior-art and integration audit.

researcher_forbidden_authority: publishing a task that has not passed Driver/taskbook dispatch review
self-approving a proposal or axiom candidate into the roadmap
representing an unapproved task-like artifact as official scheduler authority
silently treating a raw axiom candidate as Working Truth or canonical Foundation
laundering FREE_AXIOM_CANDIDATE origin into DRIVER_ROADMAP to bypass candidate maturity/provenance
relabeling a semantic continuation as NEW_DIRECTION to bypass the successor gate

official_taskbook_authority.rule: Only Driver-approved taskbooks are dispatchable. Taskbooks declare origin, lineage, identity policy/lane and task-local execution semantics but never a fixed runtime Researcher-ID. A dispatch PASS is immediately published to the shared work state through an immutable TASK_PUBLISH event so generic researcher claim can discover it without user relay. Free-candidate origin and continuation lineage are preserved rather than repackaged away. Manual Driver relay remains a fallback, not the primary task-discovery path.

proposal_capture.rule: Batch worthwhile side branches at a semantic checkpoint; Driver may APPROVE, MERGE, PARK, or REJECT them. A free-research axiom candidate uses the dedicated axiom-candidate lifecycle instead of bypassing it through a generic proposal bundle.

driver_actions: claim pending shared reviews without requiring that this Driver issued the underlying task
independently rerun or verify high-leverage claims when practical
deduplicate against prior art and existing Enterprise Math owners
continue the same task when the frontier remains inside its mother question
preserve task origin and semantic lineage when selecting new work
require an explicit successor-stage information gap and alternative-route/free-exploration consideration before opening a new continuation
close, park, or return branches that fail to leave a genuine residue
review audited free-research candidates without making raw candidates Working Truth
create or amend official taskbooks when a new direction is precise and worth dispatching
publish every dispatch-approved taskbook to the shared work state in the same turn
create review requests with exact objectives/evidence/log refs when research execution reaches DONE
preallocate Researcher-IDs only for fallback Driver-mediated manual dispatch envelopes
maintain the human researcher directory and resolve ambiguous historical identity mappings
set priority and leverage without turning recent success into the default agenda
freeze, formalize, promote, merge, or defer stable payloads
route stable capabilities into shared tools without moving theorem ownership
maintain the Driver Continuity Snapshot at semantic checkpoints
artifact_rule: Artifact creation is not progress by itself; scientific evidence, theorem/counterexample content, validated computation, formalization, reusable tooling, a mature axiom candidate, or a real routing decision is progress.
nonblocking_rule: Governance, scheduler/work-state coordination, CI, workflow, identity registration, snapshot maintenance, candidate intake and replication coordination are never mathematical HARD_BLOCK reasons.
